title: christolea flabellata
intro: Christolea flabellata, commonly known as the Tibetan rhodiola or yadong, is a plant species native to the Tibetan Plateau. It is traditionally used in Tibetan medicine to treat various health conditions, including fatigue, stress, and depression. The health benefits of Christolea flabellata include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as improving mental clarity, reducing anxiety, and enhancing overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Christolea flabellata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
